raw_segments.text: A Hackney car, number 324, driver Barton James of number 1 Harmony Avenue, Donnie Brooke,
A young gentleman, stylishly dressed in an indigable surge suit made by George Robert
Meages, tailor and cutter, of number 5 Eden Key, and wearing a straw hat very dressy,
bought of John Plasto of number 1 Great Brunswick Street, Hatter.
A, this is the jingle that joggled and jingled.
By Delugec's pork shop, bright tubes of agendeth trotted a gallant buttocked mare.
